 Performance review cycle Policy
Document owner
Sofie Claes, HR Policy Manager
Version
3.0
Status
Approved
Effective date
2025-01-01
Last updated
2026-03-27
Purpose
This policy sets out the rules on performance review cycle at Vandenberg Logistics NV.
Policy
There are two review cycles per year: a mid-year review in June and a year-end review in
December.
Conditions
New hires have a probation review after 3 months.
Validity
Version 3.0, effective 2025-01-01. Supersedes version 1.2 (2022). Approved by the Management
Committee.
